schemaVersion: 1
title: Vitest fake timers leak across files
type: knowledge-note
created: 2026-07-30
tags: [dev]
summary: Fake timers installed in one file stay installed for the next one unless a hook restores the real clock.
stage: emerging
author: agent
reviewed: null
---

Restore the clock in an after-each hook, so the next file starts on a real one.
